name: mitigation mechanism
definition: Harris's three-way distinction (2023): allocation assigns the risk to a named party by contract; spreading transfers it to third parties for a premium; pooling mutualises it among stakeholders with no outsider. The sort key of this census.

name: participation basis
definition: Whether participation is chosen or imposed. Theoretically loaded: if pooling raises each participant's time-average growth rate, compulsion demands an explanation, and the non-excludability of the pooled good is the usual one.

name: peril-risk bearer
definition: Who bears loss from the peril itself - shipwreck, seizure, jettison. Paired with RB2, which asks the same question of loss from the market; the pair exists because the two need not fall on the same party.

name: market-risk bearer
definition: Who bears loss from price movement and failed sale, as distinct from loss to the peril itself (RB1).

name: discharge on total loss
definition: The obligation is extinguished if the venture is lost (1 = discharged).

name: peril priced ex ante
definition: Whether the cost of bearing the peril is set before the event (1 = priced). Deliberately says PERIL, not risk: the characteristic measures the movement from a hazard conception (an event that may befall, no distribution, not priceable) to a risk conception (a quantified distribution, priceable, transferable to a party with no stake), so it cannot be named with the endpoint of the shift it measures. CODING RULE: a premium recovered by inference from a freight rate or an exchange rate is analyst-imposed, never articulated.
